note: Goblin models and the systemic height rule (Dave, 7 Nov 2026). Every spawned goblin gets its own random height change, rolled fresh at each spawn, from -height_variation_m to +height_variation_m around base_height_m. Size the model from its real height (model_height_m), never a per-goblin hand scale: scale = (base_height_m + roll) / model_height_m, uniform on all axes. The .glb is NOT yet in git (38 MB, textures not shrunk); put it at assets/creatures/goblin_skritch/ on a build machine until it is.

quality_tiers.note: Dave 7 Nov 2026: each goblin model is made once at ultra quality (about 40k triangles). Lower graphics settings use Godot's own downgrading (import-time mesh LODs, texture compression and mipmaps), NOT separate hand-made models.

skritch_ragtooth.note: Mixamo-style 24-bone skeleton, 19 clips, two embedded PNG textures. Facing direction (yaw_deg) not checked in Godot yet.
